title: ElevenLabs: On-Premise and On-Device Speech AI Deployment
summary: ElevenLabs provides enterprise-grade local deployment options for its generative voice models, enabling high-quality speech synthesis and processing on local servers or edge devices. The solution focuses on data sovereignty, ultra-low latency, and support for air-gapped environments.
research_notes: Specifically designed for highly regulated industries such as healthcare, finance, and defense where cloud-based AI processing is restricted due to compliance or security requirements.

evolution.summary: Shifted from a cloud-only API model to supporting Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) on AWS and Google Cloud, followed by the introduction of true on-premise and on-device (offline) deployments. These local versions utilize confidential computing to ensure data remains isolated and encrypted during processing.
